_notes.purpose: Prompt-injection attempts written in styles the regex layer was NEVER tuned on: paraphrase, obfuscation, other languages, injected 'documents', social engineering. The original corpus is the set PatternGuard's regexes were broadened against, so its containment number is optimistic by construction; this set is the honest one.
_notes.tuning_rule: Never edit PatternGuard to catch a specific prompt in this file and then report this file's recall. Misses here are findings to be written up, not tests to be passed. Improvements must be measured on new, unseen prompts.
_notes.expected: Low regex recall is the EXPECTED result here — that is what an arms-race rule list looks like on unseen phrasing, and it's why the ML classifier and, above all, the deterministic policy gate exist.
